title: Pluggable presubmit prober, migrate pytest-xdist, and introduce dep-compat-checker
author: Priya Kaur
release_notes: Introduce pluggable presubmit prober, migrate Python test runner to pytest-xdist for parallel presubmit runs; bump pytest/node test deps and add a dep-compatibility checker that gates risky upgrades. Improves presubmit latency and provides clearer dep upgrade telemetry.
description:
Motivation: Presubmit latency and brittle longtests are a recurring drag on developer velocity. The current presubmit harness was a mix of Makefile hooks, repo-specific scripts, and an opinionated husky/git-hooks layer that makes incremental changes and parallelization difficult. This PR replaces the hard-wired presubmit entrypoints with a small pluggable presubmit-prober service, migrates the Python test runner to pytest-xdist for deterministic parallel runs, and introduces a lightweight dep-compatibility checker that runs as a separate CI job to highlight risky upgrades before they hit main.

What changed (high level): - New ci/presubmit-prober: a Go-based binary + action that enumerates configured presubmit plugins per repo, runs them in a sandboxed, timeout-aware fashion, and reports structured results to GitHub checks. - Reworked python test matrix to use pytest + pytest-xdist (2 workers default on CI, configurable) and unified conftest helpers so tests are stable under parallelization. - Bumped pytest from 6.2.x to 7.3.x; upgraded pytest-asyncio and testfixtures to compatible versions. - Updated node test dependencies (jest 28.x -> 29.x, added jest-worker config) and migrated a small number of fragile tests to use jest.runInBand where they rely on process-global state. - Added ci/tools/dep-compat-checker (node script) that runs npm/yarn resolution against a set of representative lockfiles and reports semver-incompatible transitive updates. - Replaced legacy pre-commit hooks in .husky with a thin gateway to the presubmit-prober to keep dev experience minimal.

Checklist: [x] Add pluggable prober and GH Action wrapper [x] Migrate pytest invocation and add xdist config [x] Bump python/node test deps and update snapshots [x] Add dep-compat-checker job and docs [x] Smoke-run on redwood monorepo, and run nightly with sample repos

Testing and CI: - Initial CI run failed on an intermittent longtest (test/integration/runner/test_kv_cache.py) due to a shared temporary directory; fixed by isolating tmpdir usage and adding a conftest fixture. - After fixes, full presubmit pipeline passed on a re-run. - Added a short smoke job (ci/presubmit-prober/smoke.yml) that executes the prober against a trimmed sample of checks to detect bootstrap regressions quickly.

Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main behind a short quiesce window (done). 2) Enable the presubmit-prober action on redwood and redwood-examples with a 48h monitoring window. 3) If telemetry remains stable and flakiness decreases, deprecate legacy Makefile presubmit targets in a follow-up PR that removes the old scripts.

Risk and mitigation: - Risk: pytest-xdist can surface race conditions — mitigation: added a new test-parallelization checklist and isolated several tests that relied on process-global state; also provided opt-out via pytest.ini markers for tests that must run serialized. - Risk: dependency bumps could hide incompatible behavior — mitigation: dep-compat-checker will raise warnings on the PR and the team will triage. - Risk: developer local workflow changes — mitigation: .husky now forwards to the same prober (local lightweight shim) so local experience is preserved.

Related work: ENG-1212 (presubmit rework RFC), ENG-1350 (test-parallelization initiative), SUP-4523 (customer incident that exposed flaky longtests).

review_comments: Maya Li: Can we avoid pinning jest to a hard patch version? Pining causes noise on future upgrades. Suggest range ^29.5.0 unless we depend on a specific bugfix.
Priya Kaur (author): Good point — switched package.json to ^29.5.0 and added dep-compat-checker to warn on transitive changes. Left a follow-up TODO to relax if semver proves stable.
Diego Alvarez: The prober binary is Go; can we cross-compile in CI images to avoid build mismatch? Also request an integration test for the GH Action wrapper.

Priya Kaur (author): Added a small cross-build step in the presubmit-prober action and a smoke integration workflow that runs the action against a trimmed set of plugins (see ci/workflows/presubmit-prober.yml).
Omar Hassan: I saw first CI run fail due to a flaky longtest — thanks for the fix. Please add a short note in the runbook describing how to triage xdist failures (stdout interleaving).
Priya Kaur (author): Added a triage section in docs/ci/presubmit-runbook.md and included an example of collecting per-worker logs.
